task: Find founder-owned US specialty chemical distributors with 50-250 employees and no private equity owner

ownership_changes.why: The owner-operator founder is named as owner, and no PE or institutional owner was found. That satisfies the ownership rule.
The Hilleary family has owned the company since 1981, and CEO Brad Hilleary is listed as owner. Family-owned and owner-operated satisfy the criterion. The headcount gap is a separate criterion.
The company is family-owned and owner-operated, and no institutional owner is shown.
Hubbard-Hall is sixth-generation family-owned, which satisfies the family-owned criterion under the rule.
Family ownership is stated, and no PE or other institutional owner was found.
A press release calls it family-owned, and nothing shows an institutional owner. The source is dated (2013), so confidence is lower.

c1.note: The company's about page names Kaz Darehshori as Owner & President, says he founded it in 2002, and reports 80+ employees and $164M in sales. I found no PE owner, but no source states independence outright. The variant that cites 53 employees per LeadIQ is also within 50-250.

c4.note: Brad Hilleary is listed as CEO and owner, but the claim itself says the Hilleary family has owned it since 1981, so it is not founder-owned. Third-party headcounts are 51-100 (58-67 in most sources), well below the claimed 120+.

c5.note: Hubbard-Hall dates to 1849 and is sixth-generation family-owned under CEO Molly Kellogg, so it is not founder-owned. Headcount estimates are 67-111.

c6.note: Spectrum was founded in 1971 and is still described as family-owned, and founder Paul Burg is Co-Chairman. A 2021 press release gives 225 employees. It also manufactures, so it is only partly a distributor. I found no PE owner but no source states independence outright.

c7.source: Web search results: Brainerd's own profile (family-run, founded 1959 by Harold W. Brainerd Jr., describes itself as independent); theorg.com lists Mathew A. Brainerd as chairman and owner; Top Workplaces 2025 Oklahoma. Headcount aggregators: 82, 51-200, 51-100, 102.
c7.note: I did not open the saved pages and relied on search-result snippets. Ownership is family-held and independent, with a named family owner and no PE. Headcount estimates vary (50-102) but mostly sit inside 50-250. It is a Tulsa distributor and manufacturer of chemicals, with Mallinckrodt distributi...

c8.source: Web search results: First Midwest Group article quoting president Marc Whitcher (founded 1957 by David Whitcher, now run by the third generation); LeadIQ shows about 53 employees as of April 2026; OSHA injury data shows an average of 55.
c8.note: Family-owned (Whitcher family), with no PE owner found. Headcount is about 53-55, close to the 50 floor and some databases say 21-50 or 50-100. The OSHA figure and LeadIQ favour a pass. The sector is a Rockford chemical distributor. Confidence is moderate because of the headcount margin.

c9.note: LinkedIn page shows 106 employees, founded 1928, and calls it a fourth-generation family-operated business. It is not a pure specialty distributor, and no PE owner appears; variant B's 'about 60' headcount is not supported, since the page says 106.

c11.note: Wego's about page calls it an independent, family-built business. Headcount comes from the 2025 sustainability report; I did not confirm the exact 207 or 217 figure, and the Bert Eshaghpour ownership detail was not seen in my grep.

c13.note: The company site says it was founded in 1970 and is now a third-generation family business. LinkedIn shows 55 employees and the 51-200 size band, and no PE owner appears.

c15.note: Rabin founded Parchem in 1999 and is its chairman, but no source I saw states who owns it. The only headcount figure is Owler's 25-100 range, which does not confirm 54.

c16.source: Web search results: Thomasnet lists Andrew Brahms as Owner; Built In shows 76 employees; LeadIQ about 70; Prospeo 51-100; Cleanlink and FMLink coverage of the Handi-Clean acquisition.
c16.note: Brahms is named as owner and CEO and no PE owner appears. Headcount is about 70-76 on most sources, though Thomasnet says 10-49. The sector fit is the weak point. Armchem is a Fort Lauderdale importer/distributor of janitorial and sanitation chemicals and supplies, so it is borderline for special...

c17.note: Founded by Gabriel Baizan; Jean-Pierre Baizan is President. It is described as the largest independent chemical distributor in Texas, and its only disclosed financing is Amegy senior bank debt (Westlake release). LinkedIn gives 98 employees. 'Family-owned' is inferred from the Baizan management a...

c19.note: Lintech's own site says it is a family-owned specialty chemical distributor with 80 employees, founded 1983 in Macon, GA, and 'financially independent'. The 'woman-owned' label and the lintechinternational.com domain were not checked; the company is the same as c20.

c20.note: The page states a family-owned specialty chemical distributor, founded 1983 in Macon, GA, with 80 employees and financial independence. No PE owner appears.

c21.note: Ed Pavlish is credited with founding it in 1970. Employee estimates conflict (21-50, 26, 40, about 100) and no source names the current owner. No saved page covers this company.

c22.note: Search shows a private Louisville distributor founded 1980. Headcount estimates conflict (65, 51-100 and 95). No source states family or founder ownership. Owners listed in databases are unverified.

c23.note: A 2013 press release calls it family-owned, but that is dated. Headcount estimates range from 11-50 to 69, so 50+ is unconfirmed. No current source on ownership.

c24.note: It is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Colonial Group, a 1921-founded family company with about 2,000 employees. It is not a standalone founder-owned firm, and the group-level size is outside the 50-250 band.

c25.note: West Palm Beach distributor founded 2007 by John Lagae (CEO/Owner per The Org). PitchBook lists it as Privately Held (no backing). LinkedIn gives 90 employees and LeadIQ about 92. The 'family-owned' wording in variant D was not found in the saved pages.

c27.note: Described as a privately owned corporation in Arleta, CA, established in 1996 by Anthony Miles, who is still involved with his family. LinkedIn lists the 51-200 band, though its own count is 45. The wife Gina and the '100+' headcount were not found in the saved pages. No PE owner was found.

c28.note: Seacole's About page lists Gregg Elliott as Founder, Owner & CEO. The history page says he founded Seacole in 2002. LeadIQ gives about 56 employees as of October 2026, and Glassdoor gives 51-200. I did not check separately whether it distributes chemicals as well as formulating them, and I saw no...

c29.note: Gantrade was founded in 1975 by Mahendra Parekh, who MarketScreener lists as President. It is based in Park Ridge, NJ, and LeadIQ puts it at 51-200 employees. No saved page states who owns it, so ownership is unknown.

c11.note: Great Neck, NY family company founded in 1978. Founder Bert Eshaghpour is still CEO and principal owner. About 207–217 employees per its 2025 sustainability report. Searches found no PE owner or investment.

c13.note: A third-generation family business: the 1970 founders (Diamond and Cunningham Sr.) no longer run it, so it is not founder-owned. Not PE-owned and inside the size range (sources give 55–160 employees), but the founder-owned test fails.

c16.note: armchem.com shows a janitorial and sanitation supply distributor (paper products, dispensers, hand care, cleaning chemicals), not a specialty chemical distributor. Founded in 1982; I found nothing confirming Andrew Brahms founded it, as the claim says. No PE found.

c25.note: Founded in 2007 by John Lagae, listed by The Org as CEO/Owner. About 92 employees per LeadIQ (51–200 band). PitchBook says 'Privately Held (no backing)'. The 2009 Agrofert deal on PitchBook is a different company named GreenChem.

c28.note: The company's history page says Gregg Elliott founded Seacole in 2002 and is still founder and CEO. It makes and distributes specialty chemicals, with about 56 employees (51–200 band). Privately held; no PE or ownership change found since its 2021 deals.
